explanation: A box jellyfish's eyes sit in four clusters of six, and some have lenses. It has no brain as such, yet it uses them to steer around obstacles such as mangrove roots.

claims.text: Box jellyfish eyes are grouped in four clusters of six, and some of the eyes have lenses.
Box jellyfish have no centralized brain but use vision to steer around obstacles such as mangrove roots.
